verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Brevo serves an llms.txt at developers.brevo.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. A second probe confirms per-page clean Markdown via a .md suffix, and the llms.txt indexes substantive docs pages such as batch sending, sandbox mode and n8n. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt full-content variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
